notes.title: Leaving Early Access
notes.content:
The game has now left Early Access. We value honesty, so here's the long story short.

I, Alex 13, made this game solo as an experiment to prove I can make a pretty complex game alone. In this I succeeded. That was 5 years ago. I hoped that the game would sell well on itself - you know, that belief that games just sell themselves. The game is complete in terms of mechanics and gameplay loop - but doesn't have enough content. I had plans, thus entered the EA program but sales were miniscule so I've abandoned this game and focused on my career. 

I'm now closing the Early Access [b]without updating the game[/b]. I don't think you should buy it - it won't receive any updates. But it's still a fun little game with interesting build variety and theorycrafting potential. So take a look if you're interested. Beware atrocious UI/UX and the fonts. They bleed even my eyes.

Two years ago we've gathered a team (a no-budget team) and started working on Titans of the Past.

No Early Access for this new game. We're committing to deliver a completed, finished product.

Thank you,
Alex 13

notes.title: Our new game gets a Demo this May
notes.content:
Hello dear players,

We've been working on a new game - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3098170/Titans_of_the_Past/]Titans of the Past[/url] - for a while. 

We're releasing the Demo version for it on May 16th, 2025.

Support us by wishlisting the game!
